newsitem.title: JAPAN: Russia, Japan seen holding 1997 PGM talks in March.
newsitem.headline: Russia, Japan seen holding 1997 PGM talks in March.

text.p: Japan-Russia negotiations on export contracts for platinum group metals in calendar 1997 are likely to be held sometime in March, an official of the Russian platinum group export agency in Tokyo said on Friday.
"I think that the talks will be held in March, although I not certain, but it is my expectation," an official at the Russian platinum group export agency (Almazjuvelireexport) told Reuters.

Japan-Russia talks on one-year supply contracts for platinum group metals, usually held in mid-December, were postponed for an indefinite period due mainly to a delay in the Russian budget and a change in the structure of the Russian government. The Russian budget for 1997 was finally approved by the upper house of parliament on February 12.
